note: The previous commits add eight hyphenated-literal real-query rows and record the reference on the unchanged engine. This change makes a query that is one hyphen-joined identifier-like token verify as a literal in the exact lane: only a file containing the whole string is exact evidence (E1); the token's parts no longer supply declaration or three-line-window evidence, so they cannot carry the [exact] label or outrank the file holding the literal. The borrowed-index loading notice now says what the exact pass found instead of calling the lexical list complete. Other query shapes and their exact evidence are unchanged.
